Ubrir o directorio d'o fichero en Terminal
Aturar o script NppExec en execución
Remerar os quadros que yeran ubiertos
O texto seleccionau se puede arrocegar
Tipo de letra d'o capitero (vuedo ta lo de l'editor)

Item.english: This document is not valid JSON.
Item.text: Iste documento no ye un JSON valido.

Item.english: Set as the first file to compare.
Item.text: Definiu como primer fichero ta comparar.
O documento ye un XML valido.

Item.english: That file is open in another tab.
Item.text: Ixe fichero ye ubierto en unatra pestanya.

Item.english: Close it first, or choose another name.
Item.text: Zarre-lo antes, u trigue unatro nombre.

Item.english: Some characters cannot be represented in this encoding.
Item.text: Bells caracters no se pueden representar en ista codificación.

Item.english: The ticked project panels have no files
Item.text: Os quadros de prochecto marcaus no tienen fichers

Item.english: Hash to check the password against:
The salt is not valid hexadecimal.
Item.text: A sal no ye un hexadecimal valido.

Item.english: bcrypt takes a salt of exactly 16 bytes.
Item.text: bcrypt precisa una sal d'exactament 16 bytes.

Item.english: Argon2 takes a salt of at least 8 bytes.
Item.text: Argon2 precisa una sal de 8 bytes a lo menos.

Item.english: The hash could not be generated with these settings.
Item.text: No s'ha puesto chenerar o hash con ista configuración.

Item.english: This is not a bcrypt, scrypt, Argon2 or PBKDF2 hash.
Item.text: Isto no ye un hash bcrypt, scrypt, Argon2 u PBKDF2.
A contrasenya coincide con o hash.

Item.english: The password does not match the hash.
Item.text: A contrasenya no coincide con o hash.

Item.english: The cost must be between 4 and 31.
Item.text: O coste ha de ser entre 4 y 31.
A versión ha de ser 2a, 2b u 2y.
N ha de ser entre 2^1 y 2^24.

Item.english: r and p must be between 1 and 64.
Item.text: r y p han de ser entre 1 y 64.

Item.english: These settings need more than 2 GB of memory.
Item.text: Ista configuración precisa mas de 2 GB de memoria.

Item.english: The parallelism must be between 1 and 64.
Item.text: O paralelismo ha de ser entre 1 y 64.

Item.english: The iterations must be between 1 and 1000.
Item.text: As iteracions han de ser entre 1 y 1000.

Item.english: The memory must be at least 8 KiB for each lane.
Item.text: A memoria ha de ser a lo menos de 8 KiB por cada filo.

Item.english: These settings need more than 4 GB of memory.
Item.text: Ista configuración precisa mas de 4 GB de memoria.

Item.english: The digest must be SHA-1, SHA-256 or SHA-512.
Item.text: A función hash ha de ser SHA-1, SHA-256 u SHA-512.

Item.english: The iterations must be between 1 and 100000000.
Item.text: As iteracions han de ser entre 1 y 100000000.

Item.english: The hash length must be between 4 and 1024 bytes.
Item.text: A largaria d'o hash ha de ser entre 4 y 1024 bytes.

Item.english: The input is not bytes written in hexadecimal.
Item.text: A dentrada no son bytes escritos en hexadecimal.
A dentrada no ye un $STR_REPLACE$ valido.

Item.english: The decoded bytes are not UTF-8 text; they are shown in hexadecimal only.
Item.text: Os bytes descodificaus no son texto UTF-8; nomás s'amuestran en hexadecimal.

Item.english: Leave out characters that look alike (O 0 o I l 1)
Item.text: Excluir os caracters que se pareixen (O 0 o I l 1)

Item.english: At least one character of each kind
Item.text: A lo menos un caracter de cada clase

Item.english: Choose at least one kind of character.
Item.text: Trigue a lo menos una clase de caracters.

Item.english: Show the bare key in hexadecimal
Item.text: Amostrar a clau sola en hexadecimal

Item.english: Empty: a random salt each time
Item.text: Vuedo: una sal aleatoria cada vegada

Item.english: bcrypt reads only the first 72 bytes.
Item.text: bcrypt nomás leye os primers 72 bytes.

Item.english: One to a line: name=value. They are added to the address, encoded.
Item.text: Un por linia: nombre=valor. S'adhiben a l'adreza, codificaus.

Item.english: One to a line: Name: value
Sent as it is written, in UTF-8.
Item.text: Se ninvia tal como ye escrito, en UTF-8.

Item.english: The answer is not text: $INT_REPLACE$ bytes.
Item.text: A respuesta no ye texto: $INT_REPLACE$ bytes.

Item.english: The address is not an http or https address.
Item.text: L'adreza no ye una adreza http u https.

Item.english: This is not a curl command.
Item.text: Isto no ye una orden curl.

Item.english: The command reads its data from a file, which is not done here.
Item.text: A orden leye os suyos datos d'un fichero, cosa que aquí no se fa.

Item.english: The command's address is not an http or https address.
Item.text: L'adreza d'a orden no ye una adreza http u https.
